title: Rabbi Gershom

paragraphs: In [Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Nedarim.3.8.2) he speaks in Rabbi Acha’s name. Hyman also finds Rav Idi bar Idi bar Gershom: [Chullin 98a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.98a.9).[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Yerushalmi, Rabbi Gershom transmits in Rabbi Acha’s name. The linked Bavli gives Rav Idi bar Idi bar Gershom in a different chain and spells Gershom גרשם. The two notices are distinct.
